title: 5th Special Forces Group (Airborne) — Operational Report / Lessons Learned, period ending 31 December 1967
citation: 5th Special Forces Group (Airborne), 1st Special Forces, Operational Report - Lessons Learned for the period ending 31 December 1967, dated 12 August 1968, 203 pp. Bud Harton Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 168300010050.
notes: Two years later than Larry's tour, but valuable as a model of the record type: its annexes tabulate every detachment in the group with its commander, camp, province, grid coordinate, ethnic composition of the strike force, and a per-camp code word. Nui Ba Den appears with its grid among the C-3 (III Corps) camps. The 1965 equivalent of this report is one of the documents worth naming in a NARA request.
